target_customer: Frontier AI labs and companies that need expert-generated training data for agents
problem: Labs need high-quality expert tool-use data and data vendors rely on part-time pay. Sylvian ran competitions to attract top experts and generate that data.
business_model: Data vendor selling expert trajectories to AI labs, pricing not found
product_category: Expert data for LLMs and specialized agents

founders.name: William Huang
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: IPhO gold medal at 17.

founders.name: Niall Kehoe
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: also Harvard Medical School and Stanford research.

competitors.name: Mercor
competitors.what: Marketplace paying experts to produce AI training data
competitors.traction_then: Reported offers at a 10 billion dollar valuation in September 2025
competitors.funding_then: Series B of 100M dollars at 2B in February 2025 per a Big Think report

competitors.name: Scale AI
competitors.what: Data labeling vendor named in the Sylvian launch post as an incumbent
competitors.traction_then: Meta bought a 49 percent stake in June 2025 per a search report
competitors.funding_then: around 14.3B dollar valuation in that deal per the same report

technical_complexity.rationale: Running competitions and collecting tool-use trajectories is mainly a platform and community build, with quality control as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: A community of experts could compound, but well-funded vendors competed for the same people and customers, and the claimed 4,500 experts are the company's own figure.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large data vendors were raising at multi-billion valuations in 2025. No source ties this to Sylvian's fate.

market_need_then: Labs were spending heavily on expert data in 2025, shown by Mercor and Surge valuations. The founders claimed 4,500 experts and about 1B tokens per week, unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses sylvian.ai, the exact name on an .ai domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Competition and leaderboard framing for experts

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence found. A name link to the Sylvian fissure is unconfirmed.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Sylvian as inactive within months of the Fall 2025 batch, and no shutdown notice, press or cause was found, so the cause is not public. A later profile describes a platform for specialized agents which may indicate a repositioning, but it is undated and unconfirmed.
notes: Website sylvian.ai returned HTTP 503. Crunchbase labels the stage pre-seed but gave no amount, so no round is recorded. The launch post figures (4,500 experts) are company claims. Scale AI entry draws on the launch post for its naming and on a search summary for the Meta deal, which was not opened.
